dogecoin.text: Dogecoin enthusiasts promote the cryptocurrency through social media to boost its popularity and market value. The hidden driver is chaos—a frenzy fueled by speculation and amplified by the Dogecoin community. Speculative investments echo the historical collapse of tulip mania,

A new meme coin called $COW is launching with an airdrop campaign aimed at attracting initial users. Greed drives this spectacle, fueled by the insatiable thirst for profit. 
Futility breeds chaos; 2021’s Dogecoin frenzy proved fleeting riches erode substance. 
Meme coins rise —
